rationale: C21 is a highly plausible immediate drafting template: it was issued only three days earlier, addresses another Cabinet secretary named Charlie, accepts a resignation effective at the end of Truman's term, summarizes accomplishments during a tenure beginning in 1948, expresses gratitude, and closes with good wishes. The child follows substantially the same sequence and adapts it to Brannan's agricultural service. C11 shares the end-of-term Cabinet-resignation framework but less distinctive wording, while C25 concerns the same office and agricultural achievements but has a different structure and circumstances.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Dear Charlie: I have received your letter ... and, in accordance with your wish, I am accepting your resignation effective at the close of my term of office.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Dear Charlie: Effective at the end of my term of office, January 20, 1953, I accept your resignation ... as you have asked me to do.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-contemporaneous opening with the same familiar salutation, acceptance formula, deference to the recipient's wishes, and end-of-term effective date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I want to tell you what a genuine pleasure it has been to have you in my Cabinet during the past four and a half years.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Since you took office in May 1948, you have done a great deal...
shared_material.explanation: Both mark a Cabinet tenure beginning roughly four and a half years earlier before reviewing the secretary's accomplishments.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The remarkable progress of American agriculture during your tenure...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Since you took office in May 1948, you have done a great deal in bringing business and Government closer together... These are accomplishments of which we both can be proud.
shared_material.explanation: Parallel central section credits progress in the secretary's policy domain to accomplishments during the tenure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I offer you my thanks for what you have done for them and for me. For the future, I wish every good thing for you.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am grateful for your service during my administration... Please accept my good wishes.
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel closing movement from gratitude for administration service to personal good wishes.
